items.title: New AI-Assisted Retopology Software Launches For PC
items.excerpt: Sparseal released CozyBlanket Pro for Windows and macOS, an AI-assisted retopology app whose on-device models analyze high- and low-poly meshes and suggest topology improvements in real time, fully offline.

items.title: How Tripo P2.0 & Astra Work Together in Blender and Unity
items.excerpt: Tripo's team explains how its P2.0 3D-native foundation model and Astra agent chain asset generation with assembly, rigging, animation and Blender/Unity integration, and where human art direction and QC still matter (vendor interview).

items.title: Viral Haystack Game Dev Finds Creative Way To Mock AI Clones
items.excerpt: The developer of a viral needle-in-a-haystack indie game answered the wave of AI-generated clones with a creative jab, as Valve addressed genAI cloning at Steam Indie Connect in Korea.

items.title: itch.io will soon let you filter games with genAI disclosures out of your search results on the site, after admitting it was previously "critically lacking"
items.excerpt: itch.io will add site-wide genAI disclosures and let users filter AI-disclosed games out of search results, admitting its previous system was 'critically lacking' after uploads exploded.

items.title: Itch Removes ‘A Couple Terabytes’ Of AI Slop, Updates Filtering To Stem Tide Of Garbage Flood
items.excerpt: itch.io deleted 'a couple terabytes' of AI-generated uploads, many of them poorly optimized AI models, and updated its filtering to stem the flood of genAI projects.

items.title: Indie game website itch.io expands its "critically lacking" AI disclosure filter as 'AI slop' continues to overwhelm Steam and other storefronts
items.excerpt: itch.io expands its AI disclosure filter, shortly after revealing daily new game pages doubled in two months as AI-made projects swamp storefronts.

items.title: "Steam's review queue is clogged up by AI slop": Salacious Fire Emblem-ish Food Devils gets a delay because its devs think Valve is inundated with genAI games
items.excerpt: Food Devils' developers delayed launch, saying Steam's review queue is clogged by a flood of genAI submissions, a sign AI slop is now affecting release schedules for human-made games.

items.title: Vivrato: 97% of studio leaders use AI in some form during development in EU and North America
items.excerpt: A Vivrato survey finds 97% of studio leaders in the EU and North America use AI in development, with 94% applying it across the nine stages of game production.

items.title: Shogun 2 – Complete Edition was "not a Creative Assembly developed game," says Total War VP after it was pulled amid generative AI concerns
items.excerpt: Total War VP Roger Collum says the AI-upscaled Shogun 2 Complete Edition, pulled from sale over generative AI concerns, was externally developed and skipped Creative Assembly's internal QA.

items.title: Epic Games CEO calls Steam's AI disclosure policies "a political act"
items.excerpt: Tim Sweeney again attacked Steam's AI content disclosure requirement, calling it 'a political act' that hands developers' tool choices to hostile audiences.

items.title: 94% of Game Studios Use AI But Rate Their Integration 3/10, And That Gap Is Why “Made With AI” Labels Are Already Meaningless
items.excerpt: Studio data shows 94% of game studios use AI but rate their integration just 3/10, which Wccftech argues makes blanket 'Made with AI' labels meaningless.

items.title: War Thunder Is Getting NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering In Mid-November, Hitting Up To 400 FPS At 4K With 6X Multi Frame Generation
items.excerpt: War Thunder gets official DLSS 5 3D-guided neural rendering in mid-November, alongside Hogwarts Legacy and Where Winds Meet, hitting up to 400 fps at 4K with 6X multi frame generation.

items.title: How Gaijin Tuned DLSS 5 for War Thunder
items.excerpt: Gaijin's War Thunder art director Kirill Stupin explains how the team integrated DLSS 5 into the Dagor Engine color pipeline, made color management invertible, and tuned the neural renderer so markings, wear and materials stay faithful to the original art.

items.title: Hogwarts Legacy Adds DLSS 5 on Nov 5
items.excerpt: Hogwarts Legacy updates to DLSS 5 on November 5 with developer-tuned lifelike lighting and materials, powered by a 2X faster AI model, with War Thunder and Where Winds Meet following this month.

items.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Powers Neural Rendering and AI Characters in Games
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's technical blog details how game developers can use RTX Spark for neural rendering (DLSS Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, Multi Frame Generation, 3D-Guided Neural Rendering) and on-device AI characters.

items.title: Playgama launches AI Game Index to rank coding agents by real player engagement
items.excerpt: Playgama's first AI Game Index ranks models by real player engagement across 4,200 AI-made games: Claude Opus builds 54% of new games, but OpenAI's Astra makes the ones players like most.

items.title: Epic announces game jam where you have to use AI, then walks back the requirement
items.excerpt: Epic announced the November Epic AI MegaJam with $50k in prizes that originally required AI use, then walked back the requirement to 'highly encouraged' after backlash.

items.title: 크래프톤, K팝 AI 캐릭터 챗 서비스 '키프' 선보여
items.excerpt: 크래프톤이 K팝 AI 캐릭터 챗 서비스 '키프(Kiff)'를 국내 출시했다. 첫 아티스트 피프티피프티 멤버들이 직접 구상한 캐릭터 '웨니'와 K팝을 주제로 대화할 수 있다.

items.title: 캐릭터와 스토리 만들어 공유, AI 플랫폼 디어비 출시
items.excerpt: 디어비가 AI 컴패니언·AI UGC 플랫폼 '디어비(Dearbe)'를 정식 출시했다. 이용자가 AI 캐릭터와 대화하고 직접 캐릭터와 스토리를 만들어 공유할 수 있다.

items.title: 'AI 흔적 글이 스팀 상위권에 자주 오른다' 연구 결과 발표
items.excerpt: 독립 연구 스튜디오 크리트필드가 346개 게임의 스팀 영어 리뷰 65만여 건을 분석한 결과, 챗봇 흔적이 있는 AI 작성 리뷰가 상위권에 자주 오르며 게임 첫인상을 바꾸고 있다고 발표했다.
